summary: Explain Bitcoin Core initialization and distinguish warmup from stalled startup
details: Node progress shows current-process block index loading, AssumeUTXO validation, chainstate reinitialization and block verification stages, with elapsed time and downstream waiting reasons. Bounded read-only log observations never authorize readiness or estimate unreported progress.

The monitor distinguishes explicit RPC warmup from service failure only for a live container without exit or OOM evidence that has not previously served RPC in the observed run. Repeated warmup does not renew progress or resolve existing health alerts; absent progress uses the existing stall threshold and a separate STARTUP_STALLED alert.
Regression tests cover snapshot finalization, counters, log rotation, restarts, monitor continuity, real faults, alert recovery and isolated node-kit packaging.
operator_actions: Activate the updated node kit through the normal upgrade flow and use status --watch plus monitor alerts to inspect initialization. Existing datasets and network identities remain compatible.
